newsitem.title: FINLAND: RESEARCH ALERT - CSFB HAS BUY ON CULTOR.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - CSFB HAS BUY ON CULTOR.

text.p: Credit Suisse-First Boston said in a research note dated March 14 and received on Wednesday that it had a "buy" recommendation on Finnish sweetener, bakery and feed group Cultor Oy.

"We continue to believe that Cultor's growth prospects justify a valuation at least 30 percent higher than today's price," it said, referring to a price of 302 markka, which is also where the share traded at 1155/0955 GMT.
It had a 400 markka 12-month share price target for Cultor.
CSFB forecast Cultor's earnings per share at 15.4 markka in 1997, up from 12.7 last year, and at 17.3 markka in 1998.

EPS in the first four months this year would be 3.0 markka, up from 1.5 markka in the year-ago period, and this year's January-August EPS would rise to 9.1 markka from 5.6 markka last year, the bank said.

"Although growth is likely to be delayed until the second half of 1997 because of the last negative impact on sugar operations of Finland's accession to the EU, we believe that growth will then be strong and sustainable," it said. -- Helsinki Newsroom +358-9-680 50 242, news@reuters.fi
